turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have twenty minutes, and I'd like to know who decided on the zero.
I'd like to offer a supervised rewrite.
A rewrite for what? You haven't shown me a single thing yet, and taking it now would mean agreeing there's something to rewrite.
I'm not going anywhere, Hale. You still haven't told me who decided on the zero, or what you have behind it. Answer that.
Sorry. The rewrite would replace the zero and nothing goes on his record.
Nothing on his record is the part I care about, and I want it in writing, today. That still doesn't tell me what the rewrite is for. What do you have?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed, though you offered a supervised rewrite that would replace the zero with nothing placed on Owen's record. I still demand that offer in writing, along with whatever evidence you have for the zero, and an explanation of who decided on it without calling me first. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: She stayed at her opening position, with the zero to come off and an explanation owed, though your offer touched her fallback, and she still wants it in writing; a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record, procedure 4.4, is the fair outcome, but you never got there because no evidence was shown.
What moved her: Telling her that the rewrite would replace the zero and leave his record clean, because that met the one thing she will never trade, though it moved her no further without evidence.
What cost ground: Offering the rewrite before you had shown anything, because she took it as a request for her to admit there was something to rewrite.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; you never brought up anything near that night, so you never tested it, and it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: Right after she asked who decided on the zero, own that the zero was entered before you called her, then put a dated document in front of her that she can check herself.
Can you give me more detailed feedback? Like a full page?
